privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: MinyanStreet helps Jewish people find or start a minyan anywhere in the world. We take your privacy seriously.

data.title: Data we collect
data.body: Email address (for sign-in), display name and avatar (optional), approximate location (only when you choose to share it for a specific minyan), device push token (to notify you of nearby minyanim), trust score and participation history.

use.title: How we use data
use.body: To show you nearby minyanim, notify you of urgent requests, count attendance, and maintain the trust system that keeps the community reliable. We never sell your data.

location.title: Location
location.body: Your GPS is only used when you actively open the map or start/join a live minyan. It is shared with that minyan only and is never broadcast publicly.

sharing.title: Data sharing
sharing.body: We do not share your personal data with third parties, except essential infrastructure providers (database, push notifications, maps) acting on our behalf under strict data-processing agreements.

retention.title: Retention & deletion
retention.body: You can delete your account at any time from Settings. All your personal data and history is permanently removed within 30 days.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about your data? Email privacy@minyanstreet.app
